title: Wandesk
content: Wandesk: Build Your Own AI Desktop | Product Hunt Launching today Wandesk Launching today Build Your Own AI Desktop 782 followers Build Your Own AI Desktop 782 followers Visit website Productivity • No-code Platforms • AI Agents Wandesk is an AI desktop. Build the apps you need just by describing them. Plug in Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Kimi, Qwen — anything OpenAI-compatible. Apps share context. AI remembers you. All local. No signup. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Forum Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Open Source • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 1 Day Rank Upvote • 378 points Follow Wandesk Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info wandesk.ai GitHub Wandesk Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/wandesk-ai getviktor.com An AI coworker that actually does the work Try getviktor.com Promoted Similar Products Claude by Anthropic A family of foundational AI models 5.0 ( 819 reviews ) LLMs AI Chatbots Happycapy The agent-native computer, for the rest of us 4.7 ( 38 reviews ) AI Workflow Automation AI Engineer bolt.new Prompt, run, edit, and deploy full-stack web apps 4.5 ( 43 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Vibe Coding Tools Taskade One prompt. One app. One living workspace for teams. 4.7 ( 105 reviews ) No-Code App Builder No-Code AI Agent Builder Trae Adaptive AI IDE that helps you ship faster 4.7 ( 24 reviews ) AI Code Editors View more Subscribe Sign in Forum Threads p/wandesk-ai yanglongyun • 3d ago First thread here 👋 what's the first app you'd want AI to build for you? Hey folks Yang here I'm building Wandesk, an AI desktop where you describe an app and it gets built right there on your machine. Calorie tracker, reading list, invoice generator, bill splitter, whatever apps live next to chat, files, 0 1 View all Social X /monitor by Firecrawl Notify your AI agent when the web changes Try /monitor by Firecrawl Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment yanglongyun Wandesk Maker 📌 Hello everyone 👋 I'm Yang, building Wandesk for a while now. The short version: Wandesk is an AI desktop. You describe an app, AI builds it right there on your machine — a calorie tracker, a reading list, an invoice generator, whatever. Apps live alongside chat, files, tasks, and memory. AI remembers context across all of them. Plug in your own API keys (Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Kimi — anything OpenAI-compatible). 🔒 100% local. 🆓 100% free. No signup, no account, no cloud lock-in. Your apps, your data, your machine. Why we built it: AI products today still treat conversation as the only surface. Conversation is good for intent, bad for persistence — you don't balance your budget in a chat window. We wanted a place where AI-generated software has shape and stays. Available now on macOS and Windows. Would love to hear: - What's the first app you'd want it to build for you? - Where does it break in the first 5 minutes? (it will. tell us.) — Yang Upvote (24) Report Share 3d ago Denits

content: OpenStatus: Open-source status page and uptime monitoring system | Product Hunt OpenStatus Open-source status page and uptime monitoring system 5.0 • 2 reviews • 574 followers Open-source status page and uptime monitoring system 5.0 • 2 reviews • 574 followers Visit website Observability tools OpenStatus is an open-source uptime and synthetic monitoring platform. Monitor your API and website globally. Showcase your reliability with a public status page. Get started for free. Overview Launches 2 Reviews 2 Alternatives Customers Team Awards More This is the 2nd launch from OpenStatus. View more Openstatus MCP Health Checker Launching today Test MCP servers like a real AI client, not just a ping Visit Most monitors just send an HTTP ping. But a 200 OK is useless if the JSON-RPC handshake fails. Our tool is different because it performs a true protocol-level check, acting exactly like a real AI client. Key features: Full Handshake: Executes the spec-defined initialize, ping, and tools/list sequence. Deep Visibility: Inspect exact JSON-RPC payloads and negotiated versions. Smart Auth: Parses RFC 9728 headers on 401s to surface exact token requirements. content: MCP Bridge by Appfactor: Connect any API to any AI agent | Product Hunt Launched this week MCP Bridge by Appfactor Launched this week Connect any API to any AI agent 273 followers Connect any API to any AI agent 273 followers Visit website Automation tools • Unified API Point MCP Bridge at any REST, GraphQL, SOAP, or gRPC API. It auto-generates MCP tool definitions with typed schemas, auth, rate limiting, and response processing. Your LLM agents call enterprise APIs through one standard interface. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Options Launch tags: API • Developer Tools • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launched this week # 6 Day Rank Upvote • 200 points Follow MCP Bridge by Appfactor Add to collection Share Company Info mcp-bridge.ai MCP Bridge by Appfactor Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/mcp-bridge-by-appfactor Mintlify Knowledge infrastructure for AI agents Try Mintlify Promoted Similar Products Pipedream Connect APIs, remarkably fast. 5.0 ( 24 reviews ) No-code Platforms Automation tools fastn.ai The no-code AI orchestration platform developers love 5.0 ( 2 reviews ) No-code Platforms Automation tools Speakeasy Craft exceptional API experiences 5.0 ( 2 reviews ) Automation tools Unified API Merge Fast, secure integrations for your products and agents 4.8 ( 18 reviews ) Unified API AI Workflow Automation Eden AI Seamlessly Merging the Top AI APIs into One 4.8 ( 22 reviews ) No-code Platforms Unified API View more Subscribe Sign in Social LinkedIn X /monitor by Firecrawl Notify your AI agent when the web changes Try /monitor by Firecrawl Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Gaurav Aroraa Auto-generating typed MCP schemas from SOAP and gRPC alongside REST is the hard part others skip. We've spent cycles manually wrapping customer-side APIs with inconsistent auth patterns just to get an agent to call them reliably. How does schema inference hold up for APIs without an OpenAPI spec, or ones where the response shape varies by query? Upvote (4) Report Share 1d ago Gabriel Ciuloaica MCP Bridge by Appfactor Maker @retain_dev Nailed it — that's the part we leaned into. gRPC and GraphQL need no hand-written spec: we pull typed schemas from server reflection / introspection live off the endpoint (gRPC even synthesizes tool descriptions from message fields when proto comments are missing). SOAP uses the WSDL. The one honest gap is REST — we still need an OpenAPI spec, no inference from sample payloads yet. For varying shapes: GraphQL unions → oneOf, nullables → anyOf, OpenAPI oneOf/anyOf preserved, gRPC treated as dynamic; plus a response-processing layer that rewrites the advertised output schema to match what the agent actually gets back. Upvote (2) Report Share 1d ago fmerian Kilo Code Hunter Finally, a product to help you create a MCP server, fast and reliable. It's about time! If you don't use @MCP Bridge by Appfactor , you're ngmi. S/O for the launch, ?makers Upvote (3) Report Sha

title: Coffee Piano

content: Coffee Piano: Browser music and piano studio with visual harmony tools | Product Hunt Launched this week Coffee Piano Launched this week Browser music and piano studio with visual harmony tools 94 followers Browser music and piano studio with visual harmony tools 94 followers Visit website Most harmony tools are too theoretical or too simple. Coffee Piano combines a real piano studio, sampled Piano & Rhodes, MIDI, sustain pedal with a visual harmony engine. Orbit visuals show scales and chords as circular maps. A harmony map reveals voice leading and chord function. Reharmonize in one click per bar or full progression. Guitar diagrams sync to every chord. Works in the browser, no install, bilingual UI. Most tools are either a sound engine with no theory, or a theory reference with no sound. That disconnect is what Coffee Piano solves. It brings harmony to life visually through orbital scale and chord maps, a real piano and Rhodes engine with MIDI, smart progression generation, reharmonization, and guitar diagrams, all in the browser. Built for musicians who think in harmony, not just in notes. Would love to hear your thoughts. title: Integuru
summary: Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform. No browsers
content: Integuru: Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform. No browsers | Product Hunt Launched this week Integuru Launched this week Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform. No browsers 250 followers Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform. No browsers 250 followers Visit website Unified API Integuru generates fast, reliable APIs for any platform, without browsers or RPA. API calls complete in ~3 seconds with 99.9%+ success. Most agents today use browser automation to control web apps that lack official APIs, but this is slow and brittle. Integuru replaces browsers entirely and connects directly with the backend. Integuru covers authentication and edge cases. Integrations get auto-healing, API docs, and a 24/7 on-call maintenance team. Each API is generated end-to-end in minutes. AI agents need to access external platforms, but most platforms don’t offer official, accessible, or comprehensive APIs. That makes integration the single biggest bottleneck. To build integrations, most companies today use browser automation. But many of them have now outgrown their browser implementations . They’re running into issues with latency , reliability , and throughput . Introducing Integuru : an AI platform that automatically reverse-engineers a website’s backend . It generates integrations that directly hit website servers. Today, our main users are vertical AI companies in healthcare, logistics, proptech, legal, and more. On Integuru, you can generate your ideal integration end-to-end in minutes , including support for authentication. In real production environments for existing users, API calls complete in ~3 seconds with 99.9%+ success , including deployments above 1M requests/month/platform
